title.zh: 安全警报：X100正遭攻击，已损失约485万美元
title.en: 安全警报：X100正遭攻击，已损失约485万美元

current_state.zh: Blockaid disclosed an active attack on Ethereum project X100 in which an attacker captured 2 of 3 Senate seats and dumped 400,000 X tokens into a self-created empty-liquidity pool, while a second attacker destroyed Freezer's Uniswap V3 liquidity position, netting roughly $4.85M in USDT across two transactions with the attack still underway.
